items.name: student-curls
items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / production 2D game sprite extraction and variation. Input reference is approved art direction sheet, NOT an output layout. Produce ONE isolated full-body character STUDENT from the left reference panel. Preserve the approved medium brown skin, short tightly curled dark hair and boy's face.
Output portrait PNG 1024x1536 with ACTUAL transparent alpha background, not white and not a painted checkerboard. No text, labels, sheet, floor or ground shadow, props, sash, satchel, badges. Character is a 2D raster sprite with premium sculpted 3D ANIME CHIBI appearance exactly matching approved reference. Front-facing neutral symmetrical standing pose; feet forward and slightly apart, arms relaxed slightly away from torso, all fingers clear. Fixed alignment: vertical midline x=512, highest hair around y=110, feet baseline y=1440, shoulder y=680, belt y=980. Entire body fits inside canvas with margin. Use same front-facing camera scale across variants; do NOT turn or tilt body. Soft light upper left, cloth texture, clean alpha edges.
STUDENT uniform: tan short sleeve collared shirt two pockets, yellow neckerchief with plain slide, navy straight trousers, black rounded hiking shoes. No beard, no official badges.
Do not include the other sheet elements. Preserve friendly large warm anime eyes, oversized rounded head, compact body, tasteful detailed 3D shading. Face not blank. Genuine TRANSPARENT background everywhere outside character silhouette, including between legs and hands. This will be layered in a browser so background transparency is essential.

items.name: sash
items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit and background-extraction. Reference is approved design sheet. Create ONE production 2D accessory cutout matching its exact style and materials. Isolate the dark navy SASH from the top right panel. One wide fabric band slants from UPPER LEFT to LOWER RIGHT, nearly straight but gently shaped for the front of a chibi torso. Length three times width. Navy canvas with fine stitched edging. IMPORTANT CHANGE: completely PLAIN front fabric, REMOVE all three dotted circles. No dots, no circles, no patches. The application will draw the three dotted spots and attach the existing Honor artwork separately. No buckle, logos or embellishments. Entire sash visible, crisp silhouette. Soft dimensional 3D-rendered look in a 2D raster. Warm light from upper left. Actual TRANSPARENT PNG with true alpha everywhere outside accessory and inside strap openings; no white rectangle or baked checkerboard, no ground shadow, no text, labels, sheet, character, body or hands. Center entire object with modest padding. Output portrait PNG 1024x1536. Preserve reference palette and style.
